row.title: Count RPS periods from the date of grant of the registration or orphan recognition
row.statement: For new molecules and new orphan medicines, the holder shall take the date of grant of the health registration in Mexico (or of the orphan-medicine recognition) as the cut-off date for starting its RPSs.

row.statement: When the health authority requests an RPS (by institutional e-mail and in writing), the holder shall file it through the CIS within the delivery time and for the period stated in the request letter; the requested period will be the most recent one in the product's NOM-220-SSA1-2016 calendar.

row.title: When the CNFV requests it, clarify doubts or provide additional information on the RPS
row.statement: When the CNFV requests it, the health registration holder, legal representative or orphan-medicine recognition holder must clarify any doubt or submit the additional information required, in accordance with numeral 7.4.2.5 of NOM-220-SSA1-2016.

row.title: Hold a MedDRA licence even before any report is received; plan purchase and annual renewals in advance
row.statement: A health registration holder or legal representative must have a MedDRA licence even if its PV unit has not yet received any notification, because e-Reporting Industria is the only valid notification tool; it must anticipate the licence request and the annual renewals, allowing for the time the company needs to provide the funds.
